## Governance and enforcement

From 2 August 2026, the AI Office and authorities of the Member States are responsible for implementing, supervising and enforcing the AI Act. The AI Office holds enforcement powers over GPAI models. It can request technical documentation, evaluate models, require corrective measures and issue fines for non-compliance.

2.5K views · 33 reactions | EU AI Office Gains New Powers to Enforce AI Act Rules on GPAI Models! 
An EU spokesperson said the AI Office has gained important new powers under the AI Act as of 2 August.
The AI Office, which enforces obligations for general-purpose AI model providers, can now request information, access models for evaluation and require risk mitigation measures.
The EU also said new transparency requirements have started to apply, helping people recognise when they are interacting with AI or viewing AI-generated or AI-altered content.
According to the Commission, these rules are designed to reduce the risk of deception and build trust in AI across the European Union.
The spokesperson added that more than 180 organisations have signed the Code of Practice helping put these rules into effect.
